summary: To set up for EEs: install podman or docker, python3 and pip, then pip install ansible-navigator (which includes ansible-builder), or only ansible-builder to build without testing; verify both versions.
questions: What do I need installed to build Execution Environments?
How do I install ansible-builder only?

answer_card.title: Set up for Execution Environments
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Install `podman` or `docker`, `python3`, `python3-pip`. On DNF:
   ```bash
   sudo dnf install -y podman python3 python3-pip
   ```
2. `pip3 install ansible-navigator` (includes `ansible-builder`). To only build, `pip3 install ansible-builder`.
3. Check: `ansible-navigator --version` and `ansible-builder --version`.
